title: [MCP] Warn when configurations have no tools
summary: The MCP configuration validation framework now warns when a configuration has no tools or agents enabled, including an 'Empty Configuration' rule that checks for enabled API/agent features and read-only discovery or Data Query Tools.
key_points: New 'Empty Configuration' warning rule added to detect configurations with no configured APIs, agents, or discovery tools
Warning uses configuration-filtered IsEmpty() checks for API and agent features
Read-only discovery and Data Query Tools are considered when determining if configuration is non-empty
Warning is overridable and opens configuration for review without automatically enabling features
No schema, permission, or public API signature changes
